notes.title: One of the Last Full Release
notes.notes:
Deep Voodoo Gaming’s debut game, One of the Last, launches for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive as a brutally fun and challenging VR shooter experience. Relentless zombies, destructive guns, and fast, fluid action provide the foundation for intense, first-person combat – whether you’re smashing brains through a zombie infested city in the single-player campaign, or competing against your friends in multiplayer mode.

Zombies physically climb over each other to get to players, dodging round and fighting over obstacles put in their way, stopping at nothing. Even when they have lost a limb or two!

With an endless stream of zombies players will need to literally grab whatever they can to hold back the reaching hands. Doors become shields; planks of wood become improvised zombie bashing weapons.

As well as improvised weapons, levels are littered with a range of guns from handguns to automatic rifles to the devastating Grenade Launcher and Lightning Gun. Players and guns can be boosted by perks that litter the levels in soda vending machines giving them added abilities for a limited time like more powerful bullets, invincibility and special one-off attacks.

When asked about what makes this game unique, Lead Developer, James Hunter stated “We knew that creating a unique wave shooter would require some innovative gameplay not yet seen in VR games. Having an enemy that was fully physics based and not bound to static animations and AI was key to the total immersive feel”. He went on to say, “Gamers want depth in their VR games. Asset flips and poor unsupported titles have done nothing to promote the VR ecosystem. We’re proud that we’ve released 22 major updates to our game, each adding a host of new features each time”.

Paul Sloan, Lead Level Designer, “We have created a game that is both challenging and fun to play, we have given the players enough room to develop tactics and strategies to help them fully explore levels and defend themselves from the hoard in a Virtual Reality environment.” Paul added “As a small independent developer in an emerging VR game market, by using a continually developing VR framework (VRTK), with a high regard for community feedback and play testers throughout the development process, we are proud to have produced a game that is not just another zombie shooter. It would have already been completed, released and forgotten about if it were. We have produced a game that is engaging, challenging, gives the freedom for the player to develop their own playstyle and to have fun.”

notes.title: One of the Last Full Release - 24th November
notes.notes:
Guns, knives and chair legs…use anything you can grab to fight off the zombie horde in One of the Last. Shoot, chop, push back and blowup waves of zombies as you work your way through three levels of action and puzzles in this new first person Zombie VR shooter.

One of the Last lets players fight through crowds of zombies in solo or multiplayer modes, challenging them to solve puzzles while holding back zombies. This is not as easy as it sounds as Zombies aren’t just rigid moving monstrosities but react to the environment, players and each other as they push and crawl their way towards you. Zombies physically climb over each other to get to players, dodging round and fighting over obstacles put in their way, stopping at nothing. Even when they have lost a limb or two.

Players are not completely defenseless and can construct barriers to hold back the crowds of zombies to give themselves time as they solve puzzles while moving through levels. However barriers are destructible and don’t last long with Zombies able to break through any barriers that are put in front of them.

This is why the ability to grab anything and use it as a weapon is important to survival . With an endless stream of zombies players will need to literally grab whatever they can to hold back the reaching hands. Doors become shields, planks of wood become improvised zombie bashing weapons. 

As well as improvised weapons players have access to a range of guns from handguns to automatic rifles to the devastating ray gun and lighting gun. Players and guns can be boosted by perks that litter the levels in soda vending machines giving them added abilities for a limited time like more powerful bullets, invincibility and special one-off attacks.

One of the Last offers three levels of intense zombie shooting action for casual players but for competitive gamers there are single player and multiplayer leaderboards for each map and the overall game. An opportunity to prove who would be the best at surviving in a zombie apocalypse.

When asked about what makes this game unique, lead developer, James Hunter stated “We knew that creating a unique wave shooter would require some innovative gameplay not yet seen in VR games. Having an enemy that was fully physics based and not bound to static animations and AI was key to the total immersive felt”. He went on to say, “Gamers want depth in their VR games. Asset flips and poor unsupported titles have done nothing to promote the VR ecosystem. We’re proud that we’ve released 12 major updates to our game, each adding a host of new features each time”.
Paul Sloan, Lead Level Designer,  added “As a small independant developer in an emerging VR game market, by using a continually developing VR framework (VRTK), with a high regard for community feedback and playtesters throughout the development process, we are proud to have produced a game that is not just another zombie shooter. It would have already been completed, released and forgotten about if it were. We have produced a game that is engaging, challenging, gives the freedom for the player to develop their own playstyle and to have fun.”

One of the Last will have its full release on Steam, Oculus and HTC Vive stores on Friday 24th November for £9.99 / $12.99 / €10.99. A demo of an earlier version of the game is currently available to play on Steam for free for players to get a taste of the full game. Further major additions to One of the Last will be announced in the run up to the full launch.

notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!!

We're please to announce our 10 major release! We're got a ton of new features:

[list]
    [*]Reviving in multiplayer is now in (see our videos below)
    [*]A preview of our 3rd level (Called "City Lab Works"), 
    [*]More and new puzzles
    [*]New Oculus controller set-up
    [*]Respawn at the end of rounds

We should be moving towards full release in the next 6 to 8 weeks, with the completion of the 3rd level, uber machine, more perks and we're going to increase the zombie speed and aggression at rounds 5+

notes.title: Oculus Release!!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that we now have dedicated oculus support live on Steam :D

This release is based solely on the Oculus SDK, so requires that Oculus Home is installed - it mainly addresses issues around controllers being rotated incorrectly (though we wish it was just that easy to move from OpenVR SDK to Oculus SDK lol)

In addition Oculus and Vive users can now play side by side in multiplayer :)

Please post any bugs in the following thread - we're keen to jump on them and get them fixed as soon as possible..

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/550360/discussions/0/133259956020791437/]Oculus release discussion page[/url]

- Thanks for the support!

notes.title: Release 8 - BIG UPDATE - Boss Rounds, more guns, throwable objects, new perks, increased zombie aggression and more!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753948/9b4329c9f887c27f3e4a45dcb4baa9c381e0f27d.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce our next big update with a ton of new features, guns, increased map content and play-ability!

We're taken all your advice and included as much as we possible could. Changing the zombies to spawn closer to players, increasing their aggression and ensuring that we up the visual quality (new fog, better fire particles and impact particles!) 

For those expert gamers - we can't get beyond level 21, can you????

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753948/b9b53b15660f7badd72cec006d53c5303d6da96c.png[/img]

Here's the full list of new features we added (some tweaks and bugs are mentioned towards the end):

* NEW Gorilla Boss rounds (every 5th, 10th, 15th, etc. round) 
* NEW Throwable distraction items (flares, noise generator grenade, etc.)
* NEW guns - M4A1, AK47, UMP-45 and Skorpion VZ (models, sounds, etc.)
* NEW "Extended Mag" soda tin perk (get 2x clip size of all weapons)
* NEW Smoke grenades (distract zombies)
* NEW "Dead on Dead" world perk (zombies attack each other for 20 seconds)
* NEW "Steam roller" tin perk (withstand a zombie pounding for longer)
* NEW Add 30% more to "D-Day +356" Map
* NEW death system - you float up with instructions

* Increased rate of perks being dropped
* Reduced zombie health increase per round 
* For multiplayer, the more players the more zombies per round
* Nail gun can now be placed in pocket (3D sound was fixed)
* Alter spawn system so that zombies spawn close to players (rather than anywhere)
* Zombies will respawn if players get too far from them
* Accumulate the dollar total (instead of seeing lots of +$2 for shotguns)
* Zombie head shots now give the correct amount of dollars
* Max ammo doesn't work unless in pockets
* Turn down blood flash on high damage
* Blood particles are too red, need to be more realistic
* Fixed wood and concrete particles to look more realistic
* The first fence in "D-Day +356" needs to be free
* Increase initial Shotgun ammo to needs 70 (Max ammo 100) 
* Fixed bug where dead players could pick up perks and see 100% green screen

As always, any feedback is greatly received!!

- Team Deep Voodoo

notes.title: Release 7 - New MP Map and more!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce our 7th major Early Access update (in less than 3 months!).

In addition to better ambient audio (wind, birds, etc.) we've now made the single player map ("D-Day +356") multiplayer ready - meaning a whole new map to player with your friends. On top of that we've added a new zone and cut some more Zombie holes in the existing zones.

The great new's is from this point on all our maps will run as both single or multiplayer!

You can now pick-up perks whilst holding guns, and even throw grenades (or your guns if desperate) to pick up perks that are out of reach!

We also tweaked touchpad and teleport locomotion to make their movement speeds similar!

For a full list of the new features see our [url=steamcommunity.com/app/550360/discussions/0/142261027573097677/#c142261027578695768]Release Notes[/url] (it includes all the new features you see in our new release!)

Expect to see a ton of new perks, guns and interesting things on our next release ːsteamhappyː

- Team Deep Voodoo

notes.title: Release 6 - Grenades, crawlers and pockets!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce our latest update is live! It brings some great new features:

Up coming features Thread : http://steamcommunity.com/app/550360/discussions/0/142261027573097677/

[b]New Features for this release[/b]

* Grenades!! A "wall buy" weapon, that will create...
* Crawlers!! created via close grenades (50% probability atm)
* Added in new crawler sounds
* Hip reload zone, move any weapon to your side to reload it
* Improved pocket system. Hold 2 weapons, and 2 throwables (grenades)
* Add pockets to multi-player system (seen by others)
* Pockets now highlight when selected or if "full"
* Disable one shot kills on the knife in the head (for any round)
* Re-balance money earned (with community feedback)
* Sound ambiance, add more ambient sound effect.
* Further tweaks to teleport + touchpad locomotion

[b]Bug Fixes for this release[/b]

* Picking up weapons when a pocket was "on top" of them would make them disappear
* Fix zombie sound effects (footsteps sound harsh, etc.)
* Fix issue where gun fires when purchasing a weapon (holding trigger)
* Fixed bug where Max Ammo was not firing correctly on multiplayer

Thanks again for the great support and please come talk to us in the discussion threads :)

notes.title: Release 5! Map improvements, barriers and locomotion options
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce the latest update to our game! (We're averaging between 9 and 10 days on major updates, so expect this to continue!!)

* Touchpad Locomotion added
* Totally new exterior to multi-player map (loads of new prebuilt barriers added)
* Buildable barriers in multi-player
* Barriers can be destroyed by weapons
* Wooden barriers now respawn after being broken
* Burning Zombie particles are much nicer, watch'em burn :)
* Reduced the money earned from zombie deaths
* Fixed issue with doorways not opening correct if you join late in a MP game
* Fixed issue where nail gun and shotgun did not flash when dropped
* Fixed issue with money being too easy to earn
* Rebalanced shot-gun damage and general reward mechanics

If you'd like to see what's coming up in our next release(s) then please view our coming soon thread - http://steamcommunity.com/app/550360/discussions/0/142261027573097677/

Thanks again for the great support!!

- Team Deep Voodoo

notes.title: Networking update! (video + info on our first multiplayer level!)
notes.notes:
We've just finished our first (remote) run through our network test harness, and it worked great! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RfvdTYYG0es

This video shows a game owner in a game lobby with another player, the game owner starts the game which loads the same level. At this point the two players interact with networked objects..

Next up is rolling this harness into the game, we are creating a brand new level just to allow for better testing of the network - it will be an arena style map, single area designed to be fast and unforgiving..

notes.title: Release #2
notes.notes:
Hi,

After some great feedback from our community we added in some helpful hints to get people started. We decided to get this release out before our usual bi-monthly update...

The introduction has been changed to reflect this, the voice over is now focused on helping the player, and the controllers have lots of tips and prompts to help you on your first adventure into the world.

Also added with this release are:

* Shotgun added, you can now pick up a shotgun when you've found the 4 Buddha statues to open up the rock wall.
* Movement is 1.5x further and Stamina recharges 1.5x faster than before
* Extended the first level by 20% more, there's not much zombies floating around the new section - it's just to show you what we're planning (it's not optimised so it might hit the frame rate on lower end rigs - sorry!)
* As previously said controllers have loads more tool tips and hints!
* Added sounds to the nail gun, and you can place it in your pocket...

What's next?

We've received a ton of feedback and I think we will spend more time looking at adding multi-player before expanding the level (or other VR mechanics).. any must have multiplayer comments? Post in our board!!!

James
